capabilities: Draw rectangle and polygon regions on vault images
Connect images, regions, or both with labeled, directional relations
Explore connections from an image up to three hops with filters and highlights
Store image metadata and tags in companion Markdown notes
Export the graph as an editable Canvas or a PNG snapshot
disambiguation: Not a replacement for the note Graph view; it graphs images and their regions, not notes and their links.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README says physical mobile testing and multi-device conflict testing remain separate from desktop verification.
problem: Obsidian's graph view connects notes, not images, and there is no way to mark regions inside images or link images and regions to each other.

relations.evidence: Regions drawn with the Image Annotation plugin, shown in the graph and opened in that plugin.

summary: Visual workspace that maps vault images and marked regions as a zoomable graph of labeled, directional connections.
